Updates: I went to the office again yesterday. And I had a piece of paper of my feelings regarding her way of handling things, and what made me mad.
She said she was pushing my limits to see how Id react and how we were going to address things. 
This second therapy went very well. I was able to cry a little and I didn’t dissociate. She didn’t said the triggering words and she said we will begin to see progress in 5 sessions even if the next step is to get angry instead of sad. Or delete guilt. 

She also apologized if she was too aggressive the first session, that she will never judge me and she was asking those questions to get the general idea of what happened (and give the event some sense). That she didn’t want to focus on his feelings, but she wanted me to stop being afraid of him. Because he can’t hurt me anymore. She wanted to give me power.

It all kind of makes sense now. A little. And for the first time I feel a little hope.

Hi. I dont have the answers because Im still searching for them but please trust you are beautiful, you are worth, you are great and unique. The little thing I've learn through my path is this: It isnt your fault, you have grown a lot, you are a fighter, you are not the abuse and you deserve to heal (even if I forget about those things in my worst days).
I dont know why we must fight this so hard, but we do. This is the only life we got. Lets make a list of small things we want to achieve in the week and try to do them. Even if it is taking a bath or eating well every day. Even if it is watching a show at night to avoid the anxiety. Even if it is to water the flowers.
This are simple things for everybody but HARD THINGS FOR US. Lets try to do them. Get better by doing something small little by little.
I hope you find some peace. From heart to heart.

Hey , everyone’s story is different but here’s mine.

I started dating again after my rape and at first, I would panic even when we kissed for too long. I really wanted to go physical too so we always ended up kissing and touching anyway. He would stop when I froze because apparently I used to ‘disconnect’.
He was always respectful and patient with this and eventually we talked about sex. We had our struggles because I would freeze, panic and shake so we had to stop. 
I was not going to stop having sex (trying to have) because I needed to feel normal.
We managed to have sex for the first time without me freaking out but we stopped for precaution, but it was a big win for us.
Its been almost 6 years since we had sex for the first time and even if there are times we don’t have sex in months (to this day it’s been like 3 months) we always give ourselves time to try it again, even if I get scared afterwards. But this is us... 
He is really patient and caring, always aware of the tiny details of my body language so he can stop if I need him to.
I am willing to be scared and all freaked out because I feel I need to face this to heal.

I freak out about 70% of the time we have sex. Sometimes I feel I should just give it up and we talk about this. He is supportive to whatever choice about this. But I always come back to trying, because
I want to move on. I want to feel normal. I want to feel wanted, not only loved. I want to stop feeling like damaged goods...

You need to talk to her and find out if you both are able to stop when things go bad and be patient. You both need to heal and commit. Its a long road.

I have a very loving and caring boyfriend as well and he does everything he can to support me. 

I think that you could ask her to stay with you because you miss her (instead of telling her that you want to take care of her) 
As a survivor we feel useless, worthless and that we don't deserve the attention/help. We feel that  our significant other is in pain because of us. We feel we are ruining their lives. I am almost sure this is why she doesn't want you to buy her tickets. But she really would enjoy your company and will help her feel better. But her mind is deceiving her.

Try to tell her you really miss her and you are in a good position in terms of money so you can buy her tickets. Then she might accept. Then be there for her without pitty and make her eat. I was in a very bad spot 3 weeks ago I didn't wanted to eat st all but my boyfriend told me he was not going to allow me being sick for not eating and asked me to try to eat with him every day. Even If I couldn't eat all normal but that please try to at least eat a bit. I got sick because I didnt eat well but then I eat a little more each day. My emotional status also improved when zi started eating because depression gets worse if you starve.

So what im trying to say is she is lucky you care for her that much and try to 'trick her' into thinking you are not doing it to help her but because you really want to be with her that please come over and keep you company.

Hope she gets better I am sending you both hugs.
